subject: Re: Kickoff: Differentiable Data Selection for vision training
body:
Decisions ahead of the June 26 OKR lock.

1. The pilot ran on the partial budget we had confirmed in writing: two of the four planned internal-corpus configurations. Result: +1.1 accuracy on the noisy-label corpus, which supports Quentin's hypothesis that DDS earns more where data quality is worse.
2. Q3 recommendation: adopt DDS for the two noisiest training corpora only. I am writing a scoped OKR around those, not a blanket rollout.
3. The remaining two pilot configurations run in Q3 only if the B-13 funding is confirmed in writing -- Bao, please push to close that with Finance this week; it has been pending too long.

Thanks all. Solid, evidence-shaped half.

Lucia
